## Kairos Pharma Presents at United Scientific Group’s 11th International Conference on Cancer Research & Drug Development


November 3, 2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 125 KB](https://s204.q4cdn.com/681232979/files/doc_news/Kairos-Pharma-Presents-at-United-Scientific-Groups-11th-International-Conference-on-Cancer-Research--Drug-Development-2026.pdf)


*Houston conference serves as a platform devoted to advancing the field of basic, preclinical, and translational cancer research*


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Kairos Pharma, Ltd. (NYSE American: KAPA), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company addressing drug resistance in cancer, announces that Neil Bhowmick, President and Chief Scientific Officer, presents today on Kairos Pharma’s lead candidate ENV-105 and its interim efficacy results at the United Scientific Group’s[11th International Conference on Cancer Research & Drug Development](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcancer.unitedscientificgroup.org%2Fspeakers&esheet=54634277&newsitemid=20261103858849&lan=en-US&anchor=11th+International+Conference+on+Cancer+Research+%26amp%3B+Drug+Development&index=1&md5=81fa40c705bc07ab515d6bbdc0ddd80c) (Cancer R&D 2026) in Houston, TX.


Kairos Pharma’s current programs with ENV-105, a first-in-class CD105/BMP signaling inhibitor, include a Phase 1 trial in EGFR-driven non-small cell lung cancer and a Phase 2 trial evaluating ENV-105 (carotuximab) in combination with apalutamide in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC). A positive interim analysis in the phase 2 trial demonstrated a statistically significant difference in progression-free survival (PFS) between all patients in the trial treated with ENV-105 plus apalutamide and those treated with apalutamide alone. Median PFS was 17.7 months with the combination compared with 2 months with apalutamide alone (P=0.0008). The trial will now focus on first line therapy after enzalutamide, incorporating first line resistance in a larger group.


Previous published work has demonstrated the efficacy of ENV-105 in radiation sensitization in prostate cancer preclinical models. CD105 is upregulated in response to standard androgen receptor inhibition and in response to ionizing radiation, driving pro-survival BMP-SMAD signaling pathways underlying therapy resistance.


“We are excited to present the clinical progress of ENV-105 at this international platform of oncologists, researchers, and industry leaders,” shared Neil Bhowmick. “These findings support our hypothesis that CD105-targeting interrupts an important mechanism of treatment resistance to restore sensitivity to established cancer therapies.”


**About Cancer R&D 2026** The 2026 International Conference on Cancer Research and Development (Cancer R&D 2026) is a prestigious three-day congress devoted to advancing the field of basic, preclinical, and translational cancer research. Hosted by United Scientific Group, a distinguished non-profit organization committed to the progression of cancer research, Cancer R&D serves as a platform to foster innovation, cultivate knowledge, and encourage meaningful connections and collaborations within the global cancer research community.


**About Kairos Pharma Ltd.** Based in Los Angeles, California, Kairos Pharma Ltd. (NYSE American: KAPA) is at the forefront of oncology therapeutics, utilizing structural biology to overcome drug resistance and immune suppression in cancer. Kairos Pharma's lead candidate, ENV-105 (carotuximab), is an antibody targeting CD105 — a protein identified as a key driver of resistance and disease relapse in response to standard cancer therapy. ENV-105 aims to reverse drug resistance by targeting CD105 and restore the effectiveness of standard therapies across multiple cancer types. For more information, visit[kairospharma.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kairospharma.com&esheet=54634277&newsitemid=20261103858849&lan=en-US&anchor=kairospharma.com&index=2&md5=517be69eae9b5b57cb058146fe012016) .
